claire: FYI starting invoices_payments migration prep in 15m. Window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Will pin checkout-api to v3.2.0 and run backfill for column invoice_tax_code.

noah: ACK. estimated rows? batch size? any table locks?

claire: ~9.8M rows. Backfill batched updates. ALTER ADD COLUMN is instant, no full-table exclusive expected. Using BATCH=4000 and SLEEP=200ms.

miguel: Add deploy config: MAX_WORKERS=8 and enable --traffic-dampen readings to route 75% reads to replicas.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @claire: migration-job v2026-06-18 queued. starting canary on 2 workers with sample=8k.

noah: Canary success criteria?

claire: Criteria: 0 constraint errors, median batch latency <250ms, peak lock_wait <60ms. Also run quick SQL check after each batch:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices_payments WHERE invoice_tax_code IS NULL AND status='active';
```

deploy-bot: canary done: 8k rows, 0 violations, median batch 160ms, peak lock_wait 28ms. marking canary PASS.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor lock_waits and long txns. holdpoint: lock_waits >50ms for 2m OR any replication lag >5s.

den a: Adding auto-pause: deploy-bot flag --auto-pause-errors=3 and post logs to s3://redwood-migration-logs/1769601111/.

claire: Rolling to 20% workers now. Posting release note: "invoice_tax_code added/backfilled. Pin checkout-api v3.2.0 for window. snapshot: rds-prod-snap-2026-06-18-2300; revert: rds-restore --from rds-prod-snap-2026-06-18-2300"

noah: thx. ping here if hold triggered.

deploy-bot: rollout at 20% -> progressing. watch this thread for hold/unhold commands.
